stories.title: Lead-acid battery pilot switched on at Australian university testing facility
stories.description: New Zealand-based energy storage company ArcActive, in collaboration with Origin Zero, has switched on its lead-acid battery system pilot connected to Deakin University's 7.25 MW microgrid and Origin's virtual power plant.

stories.title: China’s first 100 MW/1,000 MWh compressed CO2 storage plant connects to grid
stories.description: China Huadian has achieved the first grid connection of its 100 MW/1,000 MWh compressed CO₂ energy storage plant in Xinjiang, marking a major milestone in long-duration energy storage. The facility offers 10 hours of storage and is expected to generate 200 GWh annually, supporting renewable energy integration and reducing carbon emissions.

stories.title: Neutron's first launch slips again amid trouble with carbon composites
stories.description: Rocket Lab announced the Neutron rocket in 2021, aiming for a first flight in 2024.

stories.title: Amazon’s Bee launches two new personal AI devices, starting at $75
stories.description: Amazon-owned Bee has launched its first new AI devices since its acquisition, including an updated wearable and a credit-card-sized recorder that attaches to smartphones. The devices can summarize conversations, create to-do lists, and integrate with Alexa and Amazon shopping, with prices starting at $74.99.

stories.title: Even Benchmark thinks AI is eroding the venture pact against backing rivals
stories.description: Benchmark says the Valley’s rule against backing rivals is getting harder to keep.

stories.title: Banks expect to be hit with higher taxes in Budget
stories.description: Senior banking executives have told the BBC they expect to be "on the menu" in the chancellor's Budget tax later this month.

stories.title: China tells Israel to stop 'forced establishment' of West Bank settlements
stories.description: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi spoke to Israeli President Isaac Herzog on the sidelines of a conference.

stories.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
stories.description: arXiv:2610.21074v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt.

stories.title: From Research Goals to Scientific Closure: Evaluating Agents Through Evidence-Supported Physics Research
stories.description: arXiv:2610.21767v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can AI agents organize scientific investigations that lead to well-supported conclusions? To evaluate this capability, we introduce PhysClosureBench, a benchmark of 50 expert-verified, goal-specified research tasks spanning strong-field, attosecond, and neighboring physics areas.

stories.title: Orchestrating LLM Agents for Scientific Research: A Pilot Study of Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) Generation and Evaluation
stories.description: arXiv:2602.18891v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Advances in large language models (LLMs) are rapidly transforming scientific work, yet empirical evidence on how these systems reshape research activities remains limited.

stories.title: Electrifying everything
stories.description: COP31 aims to increase electricity’s share of global final energy demand from 20% to 35% by 2035, accelerating the transition to clean, affordable energy through electrification.
